historical_matched_case.limitations: Same frozen three questions, two modes, corpus, extraction, embeddings, annotations and runtime; source context, packing and scope implementation changed. This is one stochastic development-subset pass, not held-out generalization. Plans, sufficiency checks and candidate rankings may change with new context. Before/after latency paths differ when a prior refusal becomes a generated answer; no causal performance claim.
historical_matched_case.method: Baseline requested-point scores retained verbatim, with independent current review. Compare all six question/mode pairs on the byte-identical isolated index copy, preserve improvements and regressions per point, and retain both raw answers and actual supplied evidence.

validity.annotation_limit: Three reused development rows from one original page, not a held-out or exhaustive table benchmark. No correctness claim for unannotated rows, footer totals, OCR, chart/figure understanding or formulas.
validity.latency_limit: One stochastic pass with three samples per arm; shared sequential process, provider/network waiting, caching and lazy model loading prevent causal performance attribution.
validity.historical_records: Read-only comparison; prior questions, scores and artifacts were not changed.

evaluator_attempts.correction: No semantic score or failed result is repaired. Every analysis attempt uses a new output/record name; any correction must remain explicit in the run report.
